warnings.headline: Yellow Wind Eastern Götaland's coastal region
warnings.description:
During Sunday windy weather with very strong gusts.; What happens?: On Sunday, the southerly wind will increase in connection with a large-scale low pressure area moving in over Sweden. We expect to reach wind speeds of 18 to 22 meters per second in gusts. The wind will decrease slightly in the afternoon, but windy weather will continue during the day. It is also expected to be windy on Monday, when we will get westerly winds.; What should I think about?: Roads may be blocked by fallen trees or branches.

warnings.headline: Yellow Gale 18-24 m/s Southern Baltic
warnings.description:
Night to Sunday south 14-17 m/s. Sunday morning 15-20 m/s. Sunday afternoon southwest-south 14-17 m/s.; What should I think about?: Pay close attention to the marine forecast and prepare crew and vessel for high winds and seas.
Keep in mind that the wind gusts are often significantly higher than the average wind.; Where?: Southern Baltic
